heroSubtitle: Considered forms, natural textures and the quiet beauty of concrete.
introTitle: Built to be noticed. Made to belong.
introDescription: A collection of sculptural concrete washbasins designed to bring texture, simplicity and character into contemporary interiors.
aboutDescription: Nicolas Khobelia creates minimal concrete pieces with an appreciation for natural textures and uncomplicated forms. Explore the collection or get in touch to discuss a specific piece.
contactDescription: Interested in a piece or planning a project? Send an inquiry with a few details and we'll get back to you.
